title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
About Nebius :

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of GPU clusters and other critical IT infrastructure components that power next-generation AI workloads. In this high-impact role, you’ll coordinate engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams to deliver GPU clusters and critical IT infrastructure at hyperscale. You’ll work closely with infrastructure leadership to define strategy, manage risk, and ensure on-time, high-quality launches. You’ll play a key role in scaling our global infrastructure footprint across the United States market.
Travel: This position may require on-site presence at data centers during key deployment phases.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead end-to-end delivery of new data center programs, from design through handover to operations.

• Define and manage scope, schedule, and risks, maintaining focus on critical paths and proactive issue resolution.

• Translate business and technical requirements into actionable project plans and measurable deliverables.

• Oversee vendor and contractor execution, ensuring quality, budget, and schedule.

• Provide structured program reporting, including dashboards, documentation, and executive updates.

Technical Scope & Expectations
This role requires hands-on experience with physical infrastructure delivery, not only software or coordination-based program management.
You should be comfortable working across multiple layers of infrastructure, including:

• Data center environments: understanding of IT infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, and networking dependencies before hardware installation);

• Compute infrastructure: experience with large-scale server deployments (GPU-based systems are a strong plus);

• Networking: familiarity with high-bandwidth fabrics (e.g., InfiniBand or equivalent), cabling, and integration dependencies;

• Commissioning & bring-up: exposure to system validation, burn-in testing, and readiness criteria before handover to operations.

You are not expected to be an engineer, but you should be able to:

• Engage in technical discussions confidently.

• Identify risks related to infrastructure readiness and sequencing.

• Challenge assumptions and drive resolution across engineering teams.

We expect you to have:

• 7+ years of experience in technical program or project management, with direct involvement in large-scale IT infrastructure deployments.

• Solid technical background in relevant domains, with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and challenge solutions where needed.

• Proven ability to stay focused on critical paths and drive results in fast-paced, changing environments.

• Communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate complex topics clearly.

• Leadership by influence and example in cross-functional or matrixed teams.

• Proficient with modern project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Asana, hybrid Agile/Waterfall).

It will be an added bonus if you have:

• Understanding of construction projects structure and key risk factors in facility build-outs.

• Knowledge of HPC

• Experience in business processes design or automation tools development.

title: Senior Mobile Quality Engineer
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Own the mobile test strategy:

- Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

- Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

- Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

- Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

- Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

- Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

- Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

- Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

- Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

- Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

- Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll play a vital role in evolving our data platform, which directly determines what our customers can do, how fast our product moves, and how confidently leadership can make bets. title: IT & Security Manager
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our SPINE Teams

SPINE builds and operates the technology foundation that keeps Wayve secure, connected and productive. Our teams support a mixed Mac, Windows and Linux estate across offices, labs, garages and test facilities in six countries. You’ll lead a distributed IT and security team across the UK, Germany and the US, partnering closely with our Helpdesk, Network and Compliance teams.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll lead, hire and develop a growing team while remaining hands-on for the technical decisions that matter most. You’ll set direction across identity, endpoint management, security operations, SaaS and asset lifecycle; review designs and standards; and help engineers grow into trusted domain owners. You’ll also work with peer leaders to maintain clear ownership and ensure that our controls remain effective as Wayve scales.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Owning and evolving Okta, including SSO migrations, application onboarding, access automation and the evidence behind access revocation.

- Strengthening endpoint security, vulnerability management, patching, privileged access and incident response across Mac, Windows and Linux.

- Improving device and asset lifecycle management, inventory accuracy, SaaS administration and licensing.

- Building scalable controls and reliable evidence for customer and security requirements, including TISAX, ISO 27001 or similar standards.

- Growing a newly formed team into a high-performing group of domain owners.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You’ve led an IT, security or infrastructure team, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers.

- You have deep hands-on experience with identity platforms such as Okta or Entra, endpoint management tools such as Jamf or Intune, and SaaS administration.

- You’ve managed Linux fleets alongside Mac and Windows environments.

- You have practical experience across security operations, including hardening, vulnerability and patch management, access reviews and incident response.

- You’ve implemented controls and produced evidence for a security certification or audit such as TISAX, ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

- You can use scripting or infrastructure-as-code tools to automate processes and set a strong technical standard.

- You’re comfortable scaling a multi-site corporate environment and working collaboratively with peer leaders across clearly defined areas of ownership.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Staff / Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Reinforcement Learning
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Driving Core team develops the learning methods that turn diverse driving data into robust closed-loop behavior. You'll be a technical owner for reinforcement learning within the group, working closely with researchers and engineers across AV Core, Simulation, Evaluation, and Product Engineering. Success means producing measurable improvements in driving behavior.

The Core Model Safety team develops the core model competencies that enable safe, driverless operation. In this team, you'll lead the technical direction and delivery of a learned emergency trajectory model for low-frequency, high-consequence manoeuvres such as evasive steering and emergency braking, taking the programme from problem definition through modelling, evaluation, integration, and evidence for deployment.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Senior / Staff Machine Learning Engineer in Wayve's AV Core organisation, you will advance reinforcement learning methods for end-to-end driving models. You'll identify where learning from reward or feedback can improve beyond behavior cloning, then take promising ideas from design through large-scale experiments, rigorous evaluation, and integration into our best driving models.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Shape and execute the reinforcement learning roadmap for Driving Core / Core Model Safety, selecting problems and methods against clear behavioral gaps and measurable success criteria.

- Develop and evaluate post-behavior-cloning optimization methods, including offline and off-policy reinforcement learning as well as other reward-guided approaches; design the regularization, data strategy, and diagnostics needed to make policies reliably better.

- Help improve the reward models and related learning signals used to train and evaluate driving policies, working with partner teams to strengthen their quality, scalability, and downstream usefulness.

- Build robust training and experimentation workflows using large-scale driving data; diagnose distribution shift, objective misspecification, optimization instability, and data or evaluation bias.

- Define evidence across offline metrics, open-loop tests, closed-loop simulation, and on-road evaluation, and distinguish genuine policy improvement from benchmark overfitting.

- Productionize successful methods in the shared ML stack, communicate decisions and results clearly, and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

- You have a strong track record developing and experimentally validating reinforcement learning or closely related sequential decision-making methods on complex, high-dimensional problems.

- You have a deep understanding of modern reinforcement learning fundamentals, including policy and value learning, off-policy learning, function approximation, distribution shift, and the failure modes of learned objectives.

- You have hands-on experience with behaviour cloning, reinforcement learning, or related methods.

- You're proficient in Python and PyTorch, with strong software engineering practices and hands-on experience building reliable machine learning training and evaluation systems.

- You have excellent experimental judgement: able to turn an ambiguous behavioral problem into falsifiable hypotheses, useful metrics, disciplined ablations, and clear technical decisions.

- You bring senior-level ownership and collaboration: able to lead a substantial technical area, work across research and engineering boundaries, and bring others along through clear written and verbal communication.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

INTERNATIONAL LEGAL COUNSEL (UK & GERMANY)

*German and England & Wales qualification to practice law required.

The Role

This is a newly created position within Multiverse’s Legal team, reporting directly to the General Counsel. As we expand our international footprint, this role is vital in establishing our in-house legal capability across both the UK and German markets.

You will serve as the primary legal partner for our German operations-including StackFuel GmbH and future acquisitions-while providing commercial legal support to the UK business. We are looking for a collaborative professional who enjoys working across cultures and is excited to contribute to a growing, impact-driven organisation.

What You’ll Do

- German Operations: Act as the lead legal advisor for German group entities, providing guidance on commercial, employment, and corporate matters.

- Contract Management: Lead the German commercial contracting lifecycle (B2B, B2C, and B2G), drafting and negotiating agreements that help the business scale safely.

- Regulatory Guidance: Navigate the German regulatory landscape, including vocational training regulations (AZAV), providing practical advice to support business growth.

- Strategic Integration: Support post-acquisition workstreams, including contract migrations, governance alignment, and compliance harmonisation for European M&A transactions.

- Employment Law: Advise on German employment matters, including works council engagement and equity schemes.

- External Partnerships: Manage relationships with external German counsel to ensure high-quality, cost-effective support.

- UK & Cross-Border Support: Draft and negotiate UK commercial contracts (tech, data, and partnerships) and act as a strategic bridge between UK and German business functions.

What We Are Looking For

We recognise that excellence comes from a variety of backgrounds. If you meet the core requirements below and are passionate about the role, we encourage you to apply.

Core Requirements:

- Legal Qualification: Qualified to practice law in Germany.

- Jurisdictional Experience: A strong understanding of the German legal market and experience working within the UK legal environment (e.g., in-house, international firm, or UK-based role).

- Language Proficiency: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken), with the ability to negotiate and draft legal documents in both languages.

- Commercial Law Foundation: Experience managing a variety of commercial contracts and regulatory matters.

Great to Have (but not required):

- Experience in M&A transactions or post-closing integration.

- Background in German employment law (works councils or incentive plans).

- Prior experience in an in-house environment, particularly within the tech or edtech sectors.

- Familiarity with UK commercial legal frameworks.

Skills & Attributes:

title: Support Services Analyst (Level 2)
description:

Department Overview

The Support Services Analyst (Level 2) ensures that all customer needs are promptly and professionally addressed by responding to customers’ requests, problems, questions, and concerns in a timely and accurate manner, while exercising the highest level of service and quality.

The Support Services Analyst (Level 2) is also responsible for contributing to the analysis of customer problems and requirements, the development of the solutions and workarounds, and for testing and configuring Noggin software to implement those solutions on behalf of customers.

This position will require providing coverage on Saturday and Sunday, with rest days during the Monday to Friday timeframe.

Job Description
# Customer Support

• 1.1 Provide accurate, timely and professional support to the customer’s satisfaction using phone, email, portal, forums, and chat tools.

• 1.2 Gather information about customer problems and needs and analyze to help determine the cause.

• 1.3 Contribute to the knowledge about a customer to help with future support interactions.

• 1.4 Promptly resolve issues and questions meeting SLA requirements.

• 1.5 Confirm that technical workarounds and resolutions are satisfactory before asking the customer to confirm themselves.

• 1.6 Produce reports of customer support and system usage as required.

• 1.7 Act as the first point of escalation for the offshore team

• 1.8 Assist the offshore team to answer their questions related to the system, support processes and general best practices

• 2.1 Proactively advance product knowledge to an expert level including self-education and experimentation with new product features, common tasks, and problems, and how these are applied or used within different solution settings.

• 2.3 Share product feature requests and functionality gaps with internal teams to assist in defining the product roadmap and developing highly requested features.

# Internal Collaboration & Support

• 3.1 Be the customer advocate within Noggin and take responsibility for driving issue resolution and a shared understanding of the customer perspective.

• 3.2 Coordinate and collaborate with Noggin staff (DevOps, engineering etc.) to ensure SLA requirements are understood and met, and to help achieve the best solution.

• 3.3 Investigate issues, document your findings, and attempt to find a resolution before escalating to other teams.

• 3.4 Add value to internally escalated support tickets to include replication steps, links to relevant locations, and a conversion from the Customer’s terminology into Noggin terminology.

Basic Requirements
Qualifications & Experiences
The pre-requisite qualifications and experiences necessary for success in this job are:

• Bachelor’s degree in business / commerce / information technology / computer

• science, or equivalent qualifications or experience

• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in support services and analysis

• Experience in providing support to non-technical users of software

• Experience in software requirements or problem analysis

• Experience with modern service management practices and systems

Technical Capabilities

• Technically adept with support tools, including communication and support desk software (ticketing, self-service options, and customer support features).

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Senior Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

MEET THE TEAM

We’re building a central Strategy team at the heart of Preply, driving clarity, focus, and disciplined execution across the company.

Reporting directly to our Director of Strategy & Operations, the Strategy team will work with the executive team to define company direction, shape strategic priorities, and lead the cross-functional initiatives that turn strategy into measurable business outcomes.

As Preply scales globally and prepares for its next growth chapter, we’re looking for Senior Strategy & Operations Managers to own strategic transformation projects - from improving customer retention and lifetime value to expanding beyond languages into new learning categories. You’ll work on projects that have genuine impact across the entire business.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 

1. STRATEGIC INITIATIVES & TRANSFORMATION

- Own strategic transformation projects end-to-end, typically spanning 3-12 months, with real business impact across the company.

- Lead cross-functional teams to define strategy, scope workstreams, and drive accountability to outcomes. Examples include improving customer retention and reducing churn, growing customer lifetime value through better monetization and engagement, and evaluating new market segments and product offerings as we expand beyond languages.

- Conduct data-driven analysis and market research to identify growth opportunities, diagnose root causes of business challenges, and recommend new strategic directions.

- Assess and prioritize market opportunities, potential partnerships, or M&A targets based on strategic fit and business impact.

2. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP & EXECUTION

- Influence senior leaders without formal authority - navigating competing priorities, building shared ownership, and driving decisions rather than endless discussion.

- Coordinate complex initiatives across product, marketing, operations, and other functions - managing stakeholder alignment and proactively flagging and resolving risks.

- Translate ambiguity into clear scopes and action plans. Manage parallel workstreams while maintaining focus on measurable business outcomes, not just activity.

3. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & INSIGHT

- Produce clear, data-backed narratives for leadership and the board - tailoring messaging for different audiences (CEO vs. functional leads) and communicating complex ideas with precision.

- Present findings and recommendations with both confidence and presence - you’re a thought partner in the room, not just a presenter of decks.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

- 7+ years of experience in strategy, operations, or leading cross-functional strategic initiatives - ideally in high-growth tech or marketplace environments.

- Proven track record owning strategic projects or transformation initiatives from scope to delivery - not just planning or analysis.

- Strong commercial acumen - understanding of marketplace dynamics, business models, monetization, and growth mechanics. Ability to connect strategy to financial outcomes.

- Exceptional strategic and analytical thinking - structures ambiguou

title: Associate Support Engineer
description:
Associate Support Engineer

What we’re looking for
SMG is looking for an Associate Support Engineer to provide front-line operational and technical support across our products and services. You’ll help clients resolve everyday application, access, configuration, reporting, and troubleshooting needs while partnering with internal teams when issues require deeper expertise. This role is a strong fit for someone who combines technical curiosity, careful execution, and clear communication to keep client requests moving and deliver high-quality support experience.

What you’ll do

• Handle client requests through tickets and calls, resolving operational and technical issues while delivering a high-quality customer experience.

• Support day-to-day client needs including password resets, user access requests, standard configuration updates, basic reporting changes, and common troubleshooting requests.

• Use established documentation, tools, and troubleshooting steps to resolve routine application, configuration, and web-based issues.

• Gather complete diagnostic information for issues outside your scope and route them to the appropriate team to support efficient resolution.

• Follow up with clients and internal stakeholders on open requests, maintaining accurate ticket notes, documentation, and status updates.

• Perform quality control testing on support changes and client deliverables to confirm outputs are accurate and aligned to requirements.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to clarify business needs, support deliverables, and maintain alignment with product, process, and quality standards.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to documentation, templates, tools, and work processes while building knowledge of SMG products, tools, and technologies.

What success looks like

• Within 30 days, build working knowledge of SMG products, support tools, documentation, and standard processes, and begin resolving routine client requests with appropriate guidance.

• Within 60 days, independently manage a consistent volume of common support requests, document work accurately, and escalate more complex issues with complete diagnostic information.

• Within 90 days, deliver reliable front-line support across common client needs, contribute improvements that reduce repeat issues or increase efficiency, and participate effectively in required application support coverage.

Why you’ll love SMG

• We work with some of the world’s biggest and most valued brands.

• We’re fully remote, and we’re staying that way.

• We offer competitive compensation and benefits, which include but aren’t limited to:

• Unlimited PTO

• Extended parental leave

• Company-issued equipment and tools

• A culture built on connection, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll bring

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in technical customer support or service delivery.

• Experience supporting and troubleshooting applications or large-scale systems, including web-based applications.

• Working knowledge of application configuration, web-based platforms, support tools, and basic technical concepts such as HTML, SQL, data modeling, or system process design.

• Strong written and verbal communication, troubleshooting, prioritization, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and participate in application support coverage as business needs require.

Preferred:
• Experience supporting applications in a SaaS environment.
Who we are
SMG is an experience management (XM) partner to many of the world’s leading restaurant, retail, and consumer services brands.
With 30+ years of history under our belt, we pair an AI-native enterprise software platform with unmatched professional services to help organizations generate new revenue, grow existing revenue, reduce detractors, and drive operational efficiencies.

title: Senior Hive Member - Europe Hive
description:

At CovertSwarm , we're redefining offensive security through constant, relentless attack. As a Senior Hive Member, you'll lead sophisticated operations that push beyond traditional boundaries, mentoring fellow operators while discovering new attack vectors that others miss.
The Opportunity
This isn't just another testing role. You're an experienced operator who thrives on finding creative ways to breach sophisticated defences and can find previously unknown vulnerabilities. You'll lead complex operations, mentor rising talent, and help shape the future of offensive security.
The Arsenal (Core Responsibilities)

• Perform advanced red team operations and specialized security assessments across multiple domains

• Guide clients through complex security challenges, from technical teams to C-suite executives

• Mentor and elevate fellow Hive members, sharing your expertise to strengthen the Swarm

• Pioneer new attack methodologies and automated tooling that benefit the entire team

• Own and evolve key aspects of our operation (tooling / methodology / repositories / process)

• Shape our community through regular technical content creation and knowledge sharing

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders while maintaining our high standards of client communication

The Operator (What Makes You Great)

• Proven experience in one or more cybersecurity testing domains

• Strong foundation in network and/or application security

• Expertise with both manual and automated security tools

• Ability to think creatively and adapt attack methodologies

The Human Element

• Sharp analytical mind with keen attention to detail

• Natural problem solver who thrives on complex challenges

• Clear communicator who can translate technical concepts for any audience

• Self-driven learner committed to continuous professional development

• Team player who contributes to the collective knowledge of the Swarm

The Credentials
We’d like to see one or more of the following:

• CCT-INF (CREST Certified Tester - Infrastructure)

• CCT-APP (CREST Certified Tester - Application)

• CSTL (Cyber Scheme Team Leader)

• CCRTM/CCSAM (CREST Certified Red Team Manager)

• CCRTS/CCSAS (CREST Certified Red Team Specialist)

We’d also like to see you having a couple of the following:

• OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)

• CREST CRT (CREST Registered Penetration Tester)

The Perks

• Join a team that values both excellence and balance:

• True remote flexibility - work from anywhere

• No report writing drudgery - we use our custom portal

• Unlimited training to keep your skills sharp

• Unlimited vacation - because burnout helps no one

• Private medical insurance and pension scheme

• Conference speaking bonuses

• Hardware, software, and research materials you need to excel

• A culture of radical candor and continuous improvement

The Culture
At CovertSwarm , we take pride in pushing the boundaries of offensive security. Our team consists of passionate and humble professionals who value creativity, technical excellence, and delivering results that matter. We embrace collaboration, innovation, and a relentless drive to improve. If you share these values and want to be part of a team disrupting the industry, we want to hear from you.
Ready to join the Swarm?
Take the next step in your cybersecurity career by applying today. Let’s talk about how your skills, passion, and potential align with CovertSwarm ’s mission to redefine offensive security.

title: Sales Representative
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collect is a global product and technology group dedicated to revolutionizing the world of collectibles. Every single day our team of experienced product leaders, engineers, and operators obsesses over how to create the ultimate collector experience with our products: Topps.com, the direct to consumer ecommerce platform of the Topps brand, Fanatics Collect, the most trusted and dynamic collector focused marketplace, and our collector focused live shopping platforms, Fanatics Live and Voggt.

We have the unique advantage of being backed by Fanatics - the world’s largest sports merchandiser, with more than 900 global sports relationships, 90+ million reachable fans, and exclusive licensing deals with the MLB, NFL, and NBA among many others - but we’re a nimble, ambitious team building products from the ground up.

If you're passionate about building world class products and share our love for sports fans and collectors, Fanatics Collect offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team creating the future of collecting.

 

About the Role

Reporting to the Business Development Manager, the Sales Representative is responsible for a variety of duties and responsibilities in support of the company’s Sales department including contacting potential customers, reporting and analyzing sales statistics, and confirming merchandise from sellers to be placed in auction, fixed price, and/or to be stored in our on-site vault.

The Sales Representative must demonstrate high-level abilities including problem solving skills.

This will mostly be a remote position but if commutable, there will be some in office hours. Details to be finalized with the Sales Manager.  

  Responsibilities:

• Provide direct communication (phone, email, text, social media) with clients outlining and assisting with all of Fanatics Collect services through auctions, fixed price marketplace, private sales, and vault storage.

• Respond to issues and questions presented by direct clients pertaining to submissions, curation, invoices, and the buying and selling of assets.

• Knowledge of the current trends and timing within the trading card market.

• Coordinate with Customer Service, Operations, and Sales Support with day to day needs for clients.

• Maintain reports of asset submissions.

• Track data related to the final sales of assets.

• Facilitate private sales.

• Customer account maintenance.

• Onboard net new business to business partners.

• Working with business owners to help elevate their business.

• Travelling to trade shows.

• Responding with a sense of urgency.

• Elite customer service.

• Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Lead Product Manager - Ethernet Network owns the strategy, roadmap, delivery, go-to-market execution, and lifecycle performance of Lumen’s Ethernet network product. This role serves as the accountable business voice for the product within its Agile Release Train (ART), translating customer needs, market opportunities, product-line priorities, and network strategy into a clear, prioritized feature backlog that engineering teams can execute. The Lead Product Manager partners across architecture, engineering, operations, sales, marketing, finance, legal, and regulatory teams to evolve the Ethernet network, improve customer outcomes, and deliver sustainable revenue and margin growth. The role requires strong technical and commercial judgment, disciplined product leadership, and hands-on Agile Product Manager accountability within Lumen’s SAFe operating model.

• Partner with Technical Program Managers and delivery leaders to coordinate cross-team dependencies and maintain transparency on scope, sequencing, milestones, and delivery health.

• Lead product-level business planning, including business cases, pricing inputs, investment and resource needs, revenue and margin opportunities, and ongoing measurement of ROI, KPIs, OKRs, and backlog health.

GoCardless , a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit and follow us on LinkedIn @ GoCardless .

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

Intro to the Regulatory and Compliance team
The Regulatory and Compliance team is responsible for supporting the regulatory and compliance aspects of our products and services and managing the compliant execution of our business. We work on exciting and challenging regulatory and compliance issues and pave the way for our company to deliver superb products in a compliant manner. We are at the forefront of GoCardless ’ expansion in North America by paving the way with the right regulatory licensing strategy and the implementation of forward-thinking and appropriate processes and controls that require problem-solving and innovative thinking.
The role
You will be responsible for all US and Canada regulatory and compliance matters at GoCardless and entrusted with developing a comprehensive regulatory strategy and the deployment of the compliance programs. • Developing a comprehensive regulatory strategy for the US and Canada that is fit for GoCardless ’ current business and strategic objectives

• Obtaining (if needed) and maintaining all requisite licences and authorizations (including managing of changes in scope of products and org)

• Managing regulatory oversight, controls, reporting and engagement for the US and Canada

• Managing regulatory examinations and audits

• Supporting corporate governance to maintain good standing and meet obligations

• In collaboration with product counsel and other members of the team, conducting regulatory assessments to identify regulatory risks and a path to compliance

• As the Compliance Officer, and in collaboration with the Global MLRO and the Financial Crimes team, overseeing and managing the implementation of the AML/CTF and Sanctions compliance programs in the US and Canada

• Supporting the implementation/localization of various compliance programs in the US and Canada

• Supporting the relevant regulatory and compliance training of the Board, executive management, and other employees

• Supporting the development of a network of banks and other partner financial institutions that underpin the operation of GoCardless ’ products

• Providing advice and counsel to business and product groups relating to payment scheme rule compliance and other relevant regulatory requirements regarding compliance obligations

We are looking for someone with experience in regulated financial services and passionate about helping us continue to innovate in the fast-paced fintech industry.

title: Client Growth Manager (1504)

Anaqua is looking for a highly motivated Client Growth Manager who is seeking an opportunity to work in a progressive and dynamic environment and is eager to participate in growing intellectual property (IP) software and service adoption throughout Anaqua’s world class client community. This position will be part of our Global Sales team but will focus on selling exclusively into named client accounts. The goal of this position is to drive revenue by increasing adoption of Anaqua’s software and services in our client community. Client Growth Managers are involved in pitching our full range of products and services to clients. This position will work very closely with our Client Success team to focus on the overall satisfaction and success of our clients, while delivering incremental revenue. 

You’ll love this job if you like to: 

• Continue to increase revenue within a growing client community 

• Work with the Client Growth Director and the Client Success team to develop and implement overall account strategies for long term growth of Anaqua clients. 

• Facilitate client adoption and drive the company's value proposition by understanding and supporting client-desired business outcomes. 

• Proactively coordinate regular activity at your named client accounts to stay engaged and introduce new products and services. 

• Provide overviews of the products and services to the client, including running live demos 

• Help prepare proposals and responses to RFPs. 

• Work with Professional Services to scope and draft statements of work (SOWs) based on client requirements. 

• Partner with Legal to facilitate contracting, including finalizing amendments and SOWs. 

• Maintain the required Salesforce data for KPI reporting. 

• Cultivate client knowledge of and appreciation for the company and software. 

• Participate in selling and closing as part of the company's Sales Team. 

• Own a quota and leverage Targeted Account Selling methodology while working with clients. 

What you’ll need to be successful: 

• Bachelor's degree required 

• 8+ years of sales experience 

• A positive "can do" attitude with the ability to creatively maximize efforts and find solutions where needed. Must be a team player with high energy and the ability to work independently. 

• Willingness to learn and gain a strong understanding of the area of intellectual property (any knowledge or experience with Intellectual Property (Patents, Trademarks, Copyrights, Domains) is strongly preferred). 

• A critical part of this role is becoming an expert on Anaqua’s software. Technology, software and demo experience is strongly preferred. 

• Strong organizational skills and an ability to effectively manage a variety of stakeholders and active opportunities 

• Ability to influence and collaborate with others inside and outside the organization 

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail with the ability to communicate confidently and effectively via phone, email or in person. 

• Experience entering data into and using Salesforce.com or other CRM software is a plus. 

Perks & Benefits :

• Hybrid or fully remote work model

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Casual and fun work environment

• 3 weeks of vacation

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

As Founding Product Manager, you’ll be our first product hire in the US and own what the US product is and how it scales. voize started as an AI voice scribe for nursing documentation and has grown into an intelligence operating layer that supports nurses and care leadership to improve care and outcomes. Today we’re live in 1 in 4 care homes in Germany, and with 5 pilots running in the US, your job is to turn them into a scaled business. - You’re action oriented. You make strong bets with partial information and adapt quickly to new information.

- You have strong product taste. You know how to be pragmatic, but hold a high bar for what you ship and where you want to go.

- Resilience is one of your strengths - you see challenges as opportunities, not obstacles

- Iterative working suits you - you test, learn, and improve constantly instead of waiting for perfection

- You value open communication and constructive feedback - and contribute to a positive team culture

- Closeness to nurses sets voize apart - every PM spends regular time on site and builds with the people who use the product, so travel across the US is an essential part of the role.

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people

title: Senior 3D Generalist Artist - 6 month contract
description:
We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.
We believe that games that deliver the most fun-per-minute have the highest chance of success. We are a start-up and not a big company, which means we’re a bit scrappy but we’re resourceful, highly collaborative and focused on outcomes and shipping builds over process and meetings.
We aim to hire multi-talented individuals who can operate autonomously and at speed, with every role at the studio being hands-on working directly on our games.
Role Overview
We’re looking to bring on a Senior 3D Generalist Artist for a 6 month contract, with potential to extend further depending on how things go.
We’re looking for a Senior 3D Generalist Artist that has experience building modular environments and character art, to contribute to art production on an exciting unannounced co-op combat game.
Key Responsibilities
1 - Create Game-Ready Art
You’ll mainly be working on modular environments, props, set dressing and character / creature work.
Success looks like:

• Understanding our art ethos and working autonomously with high level direction

• Grasping the project art style and adapting quickly

• Understanding how to construct modular environments and working to a grid

• Rapid output by focusing on getting the core elements right rather than superficial details

2 - Be a Force Multiplayer, Not Just an Asset Maker
There’s more to it than just creating assets, it’s about being an invaluable team member.
Success looks like:

• Communicating and collaborating with the team. Nurturing the synergy between disciplines and problem solving the gaps in-between

• Joining playtests and contributing to the game experience beyond art

• Identifying risks and constraints early and redirecting effort when needed

• Being pro-active and moving the project forward, even if you’re waiting for feedback or currently blocked, you know how to identify meaningful work to keep momentum

3 - Implement Assets in Engine
You’re not just handing off art assets, you’re implementing them in-engine.
Success looks like:

• Importing, setting up and hooking up assets

• Correctly handling setup for materials, prefabs, folders and naming etc

• Fixing materials, collision and general art bugs in engine

• Spotting inefficiencies and offering better solutions

• Keeping assets and scenes well optimized without sacrificing the game’s vision

Requirements

• Senior experience level. Comfortable working autonomously with high level direction, championing your area of responsibility

• Broad artistic & technical skillset: environments, props, characters / creatures

• Confident in Unity; asset implementation and fixing art bugs

• Comfortable in Blender (preferred) or able to transition quickly

• Happy to prioritize speed & efficiency

• Project first mindset: Our games look good but we’re not trying to win art awards or build stunning portfolio pieces. The experience is king.

• General understanding of supporting optimization and performance for online multiplayer titles (from an art POV)

• Bonus skills: Rigging, VFX, UI, Tech Art skills, Concept Art

Please note: This is a 6 month contract, remote-working position, open to anyone within the UK.

The Engineering Systems organization builds the tools, infrastructure, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake's engineering organization. title: Aviation Compliance Analyst- Africa
description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

ABOUT YOU AND THE ROLE
Zipline is looking for an Aviation Compliance Analyst to support aviation regulatory compliance across our Africa operations. This role will help ensure that Zipline ’s flight operations, site operations, regulatory submissions, reporting practices, and internal compliance processes remain aligned with applicable aviation requirements and Zipline ’s safety and operational standards.
You will work closely with the Global Aviation team, Africa regulatory and operations teams, and country leadership. The role may be remote, but it will require regular travel to Zipline nests and operational sites across Africa to support implementation, audits, regulatory engagement, documentation, and cross-functional training.
This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable moving between detailed compliance work and practical operational execution. The right candidate will be able to understand regulatory requirements, translate them into clear operating practices, build trust with internal and external stakeholders, and help teams maintain compliance in a fast-moving aviation environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-growing, multi-country aviation environment where structure, audit readiness and regulatory discipline are essential to operational scale.
This role is remote and includes substantial travel across the African countries in which Zipline operates.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Maintain and update aviation manuals, regulatory documents, and operating materials to align with approved operations and applicable regulations.

• Maintain compliance dashboards, trackers, and structured datasets covering licenses, permits, certificates, approvals, renewals, regulatory commitments, operational limitations, special conditions, open actions, and upcoming deadlines across multiple countries.

• Support compliance monitoring activities, including audit readiness, findings management, non-compliance tracking, CAPA follow-up, and closure-evidence capture.

title: Compensation Lead
description:
About Abridge
Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most-their patients.
Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.
We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.
The Role
Abridge is looking for an experienced Compensation Lead to own our compensation strategy, building a competitive, scalable framework that helps us attract, motivate, and reward our people as we grow. This is a foundational hire for our People Operations team.
We're looking for someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and makes sound decisions backed by data and experience, someone who stays ahead of the market rather than reacting to it.
What You’ll Do

• Conduct market benchmarking and modeling, using the right peer groups, to support compensation program design and decision-making.

• Set the cadence for refreshing our compensation bands and own that process end-to-end, so our ranges never lag behind the market.

• Bring a strong, well-informed point of view on compensation, including executive comp and frameworks

• Turn compensation data into a story leaders can act on. Clearly and confidently explaining the reasoning behind pay decisions and structure to executives and hiring managers.

• Advise on sales and other GTM compensation design, including OTE structuring.

• Partner with Finance and Recruiting to design and govern salary structures, incentive plans, and exception criteria, and own the clean flow of that data to Finance for budgeting.

• Build the frameworks, tools, and governance we need to scale compensation as Abridge grows and our programs mature.

• Proactively track market movement and trends in the AI space, so we're never caught off guard.

What You’ll Bring

• 6+ years of compensation experience, ideally at a high-growth tech or AI company, with real ownership of program build, not just an analytical role.

• Deep Excel fluency (modeling, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, etc) and the ability to turn messy data into insights the business can actually use.

• A track record of building benchmarking approaches and peer groups that hold up under scrutiny, and the judgment to know when the standard playbook doesn't fit.

• Strong fluency in sales compensation: OTE design, bonus structuring, and the tradeoffs that come with them.

• Command of compensation fundamentals such as job matching, market pricing, leveling and job architecture, and cyclical programs

• Experience designing and owning compensation and equity frameworks, including at the executive level, across public and private company structures.

• Excellent communication skills: the ability to turn dense analysis into something any business leader can understand and act on.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www. enterprisedb .com

EDB is hiring a Principal Technical Account Manager (TAM) for US. The Principal TAM is responsible for building and maintaining post-sales relationships with EDB’s largest and most complex customers. These customers are typically large accounts adopting Postgres and AI solutions. The Principal TAM serves as a trusted technical advisor to drive successful outcomes and to ensure that the customers become a positive reference and continue their journey on Postgres technology. The Principal TAM is also the customer's primary point of contact into all technical areas of EDB. As such, the Principal TAM’s technical abilities are critical in identifying solutions, architecture, troubleshooting issues, and answering technical questions as they arise.
What you will do…

• Establish a close working relationship with the customer’s senior technical leadership team and become their trusted advisor.

• Help EDB customers maximize the value of their Postgres investment

• Assist EDB customers to develop and deploy Postgres strategies

• Provide technical leadership for the customer's major Postgres initiatives (This may include solutions consulting, architecture guidance, and project management)

• Maintain current functional and technical knowledge of the entire EDB product line

• Provide clear and constructive product feedback to EDB’s product management teams based on customer requirements

• Help to document best practices in developing and deploying EDB solutions

• Function as a front-line technical resource for "best practice" and informal customer questions

• Travel up to 25% of the time as required

What will give you an edge…

• At least ten (10) years of hands-on experience with Postgres, Oracle, DB2 or MS SQL Server; professional certifications in any of the relational databases are desirable

• Advanced technical skills, specifically in data management platforms, operating systems, cloud technologies, and technical architecture

• Knowledgeable about data analytics and AI/ML concepts

• Experience with Kubernetes

• Excellent analytical skills regarding technical and project management issues

• Good understanding of strategic sales process

• Well-developed organizational skills with an ability to manage competing client demands

• Excellent communications and interpersonal skills, including ability to interact and communicate with CxO level personnel

• Bachelors/Masters degree in Information Technology / Computer science or equivalent technical training or industry experience preferred

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres

title: Langfuse - Product Manager
description:
Langfuse is hiring its first Product Manager. You will work with the founders to define the product vision and set the strategic direction. You will also work with Solution Architects, sales, and marketing. Your input will help shape product decisions.

Engineers at Langfuse own delivery from start to finish. They help find solutions and turn them into technical requirements. They implement and launch the work. They support each launch with documentation and changelogs. They also speak directly with customers to receive feedback on features and educate the roadmap. The whole company helps shape the quarterly roadmap. The engineering team then delivers it.

As Product Manager, you will look beyond the current quarter. You will build a deep understanding of our market and emerging trends. You will also study how engineers use AI to build agentic applications. You will use these insights to create clear product artifacts. They will define the user problems we want to solve and how we want to solve them.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT LANGFUSE:

- Shape the product direction and translate long-term opportunities into clear priorities.

- Turn customer, community, and market insights into decisions about what to build and what not to build.

- Lead new product areas from research and scoping through launch.

- Work closely with founders, engineers, designers on APIs, SDKs, infrastructure, UX, and documentation.

- Align founders, engineering, sales, marketing, and key customers without introducing unnecessary processes.

- Make the product-engineering team more effective through clear context, strong judgment, and concise written briefs.

- You will own the quarterly roadmapping process and propose in which direction we should develop Langfuse.

WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO:

- Project Management for engineers. Everyone here can organize themselves, you do not need to do this.

- Slice large projects into Linear tickets. Single engineers execute on large projects in Langfuse.

- Communicate between customers and engineers. Engineers talk to customers daily.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- An experienced PM from developer tools, observability, infrastructure, data, or a similarly technical product.

- Technical enough to reason credibly about APIs, SDKs, architecture, and UX tradeoffs.

- You are hands-on: you test products, you talk to users, you maybe build a small prototype.

- Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, and product taste.

- Comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and a fast-moving environment.

- Pragmatic, calm, organized, and focused on shipping.

- Excellent written and spoken communication.

- Deeply interested in AI and already using AI tools extensively.

- Experience with open source, enterprise software, or major platform shifts is a plus.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

title: Technical CRM Specialist
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our CRM team is growing. We’re looking for a Technical CRM Specialist to join our affiliate marketing business in London.

This is an opportunity for someone with some experience with email marketing and knowledge of HTML, SQL and JavaScript, to support the team in delivering a customer-centric, automated experience across email, SMS, and messaging channels.

In this role, you’ll be supporting the CRM Technical Manager as well as CRM team and its wider ecosystem, using tools such as SparkPost, Email on Acid, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SMS integrations, Adobe Campaign and Rebrandly.

You’ll work on the end-to-end delivery of CRM initiatives that rely on data and systems so you must have the technical aptitude and knowledge with JavaScript, APIs and ideally base understanding of SQL. This includes managing incoming Jira tickets, monitoring daily campaigns, supporting the wider team, maintaining data quality and compliance, managing automations and integrations, overseeing IP warm-ups, and help build new HTML modules.

If you’re hands-on, data-driven, and comfortable operating across multiple technologies, with the coding skills listed, we’d like to hear from you.

 

Key responsibilities

- Internal SME of CRM-related systems

- Responsible for all data and compliance activities across CRM systems

- Supporting the CRM team with troubleshooting, training, and complex journey builds

- Managing new IP warm-ups

- QA for all data-related changes and system updates

- Monitoring all customer interactions

- Troubleshooting automation, journey, and HTML rendering issues

- Developing new HTML modules

- Work on launching SMS and potentially WhatsApp within Salesforce Marketing Cloud

- Working cross-functionally with Analytics, Product, and Technology teams to deliver effective, timely campaigns

- Developing and managing campaign audiences

 
 

Preferred Skills, Qualifications and Experience:

- Either Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) or Adobe Campaign working experience

- Strong data skills, including SQL and data quality control

- Good working knowledge of HTML for email

- Strong working knowledge of JavaScript

- Understanding and ideally exposure with APIs and working with JSON Objects

- Experience managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing requirements at short notice in a fast-paced environment

- Ability to work to tight deadlines, both independently and under pressure, to deliver results for stakeholders

- Commercially minded, data-literate, and highly analytical, with the ability to use raw data to generate insights and inform decisions

 

Nice to haves

- Previous experience in iGaming or a marketplace environment

- Strong understanding of email deliverability best practices, including IP warm-up, Google Postmaster, SNDS, and domain configuration

- Experience working across multiple brands, verticals, and locales

- Experience with SMS and WhatsApp channels

- Experience working in a target-driven, revenue-focused environment

What You’ll Get

- Private Health Care (Bupa)

- Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

- Travel Insurance

- Competitive Base Salary

- Company Bonus Scheme

- Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

- Market-Leading Training Program

We Live Our Core Values

Discover How Far You Can Go

Our firm has experienced steady growth since its founding in 1991 and continues to expand its client service offerings, creating new opportunities for professionals to grow their careers. We make significant investments in training and provide interesting, diverse, and intellectually stimulating work for our teams-the kind of work that helps you develop and refine your skills to advance in the profession.

HCVT is built on partnership, expertise, and a commitment to excellence. As a Tax Principal in our Tax practice, you’ll have the opportunity to lead meaningful client relationships, influence firm strategy, and shape the next generation of tax professionals. Bring your technical expertise, leadership experience, and entrepreneurial mindset - and be part of a firm that values people as much as performance.
Your role and responsibilities

• Provide top-level review of federal and multi-state income tax returns for individuals, partnerships, corporations, trusts and related workpapers

• Perform technical research and write correspondences

• Lead and trains teams of staff, seniors and managers

• Oversee planning and scheduling of engagements

• Create engagement budgets and in charge of billings

• Ensure quality of work product

• Monitor work-flow

• Coordinate constant flow of internal and external communication

• Maintain and develop business with existing and prospective clients

• Work closely with clients to advise on income tax issues and related tax planning

To be successful, these are the skills, qualities and experience you will need

• 10+ years of recent technical tax experience

• Proficient in the taxation of partnerships, limited liability companies and other similar flow-through entities; private equity tax expertise preferred

• Licensed CPA or JD

• Capable of running mid-size to large client engagements

• Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills with experience managing teams and workflows

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical abilities, and detail-orientation

• Proficiency in tax preparation software (e.g., GoSystem) and other financial analysis tools

• Ability to work effectively in a demanding, fast-paced environment while maintaining high-quality standards
